capture.note: These examples use fictional material. AI answers require review; each caption identifies the workflow shown.

screenshots.alt: LQ.AI's Contract QA skill chooser beside the fictional NDA marked ready in the chat's attached files.
screenshots.caption: The fictional NDA is attached and marked ready; the Contract QA skill chooser is open beside it.
screenshots.note: Ordinary chat in LQ.AI v0.8.0. Ready confirms text extraction; an AI answer is a separate check.
screenshots.evidence: Fresh browser capture after Docker/API recovery; the chooser is shown, not a successful Contract QA skill run.

screenshots.alt: LQ.AI matter intake contains a fictional supplier NDA review request, the NDA Review skill, and a release demo matter.
screenshots.caption: Describe a fictional review task and select the skill and matter that will guide the run.
screenshots.note: Matter intake example from the v0.8.0 release. This is an autonomous workflow, separate from ordinary chat.

screenshots.alt: Experimental LQ.AI orchestration chat displays a combined answer about payment and notice terms, with clause references and a fictional-input warning.
screenshots.caption: Inspect the combined answer and its clause references in a completed experimental Contract QA demonstration.
screenshots.note: Experimental orchestration chat, disabled by default. This earlier demo uses a different fictional agreement; its AI output is unverified.
screenshots.input: Fictional vendor agreement recorded in the ADR 0035 demonstration.

screenshots.alt: The fictional NDA demo matter contains a chat with sample-nda.md attached and marked ready.
screenshots.caption: Upload the fictional NDA and wait for its ready status before asking a question.
screenshots.note: Fresh LQ.AI v0.8.0 capture. Ready confirms text extraction, independently of a model answer.

screenshots.alt: Ordinary LQ.AI document chat answers a fictional NDA follow-up about when the five-year confidentiality clock starts, quoting from the date of disclosure; the sample is ready and the response shows Tier 1.
screenshots.caption: Ask a focused question, then compare the answer's quoted wording with Section 4 of the fictional NDA.
screenshots.note: Completed ordinary chat using the configured local GLM model in LQ.AI v0.8.0. The displayed quote matches the sample; the UI badges do not replace your review. This is separate from the skill-chooser example.

screenshots.alt: The completed fictional NDA response's Tier 1 details identify the host-ollama provider, with the question, answer and ready document behind the dialog.
screenshots.caption: Open the response's tier badge to inspect the declared route and provider.
screenshots.note: This response used the configured local route. A Tier 1 badge on one answer does not establish that document search, fallbacks or other enabled connections are local.
screenshots.input: The completed ordinary-chat response to the fictional NDA follow-up.
